title: Ẩm thực / nhà hàng / quán / F&B
summary: Appetite first: the hero bite, pour or sizzle inside the first second, then the place, the making, the dish, the reaction, the price and where to find it. Fast cuts on the music or the voice, warm grade, real sound of the kitchen kept under the music.
signals: close-ups of food, steam, pouring, cutting, cheese pull

runtime.why: Food watch-through drops fast once the dish has been seen; keep it tight.

hook.purpose: the hero moment (bite, pull, pour, sizzle) then the dish in full
hook.graphics: title: what it is and one hook word (giá, địa điểm, độ ngon)

structure.purpose: the place or the stall, the vibe
the making: cutting, frying, plating, match cuts on the action
the finished dish in macro, slow push, steam
the bite and the face; real sound up
price, address, hours, how to order

music.mood: warm, playful; drop it under sizzle and bite sounds

compliance: Prices match the menu on the day of filming; promotions with their dates
No health or medical claims ("chữa", "giảm cân", "tốt cho gan") for food or drinks
Alcohol: no appeal to minors, no drinking-and-driving, follow the platform's alcohol rules
Paid or gifted visit disclosed (commercial-content toggle)
Staff and other diners: consent, or out of frame
Music licensed for commercial use (business account)

review.about: A reviewer talks: voice-driven, the reviewer's verdict carries the video.
